description_en: Migrates a device to a different instance
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual transfer-device-instance --device-name-list example-string --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --source-instance-id iotx-oxssharez200 --target-instance-id iot-060000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferDeviceInstance

parameters.description_en: The list of device names to be migrated. A maximum of 100 device names can be specified.
parameters.description_zh: 待迁移的设备名称列表。最多包含100个设备名称。
parameters.help_en: The list of device names to be migrated. A maximum of 100 device names can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 待迁移的设备名称列表。最多包含100个设备名称
parameters.name: device_name_list

parameters.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform when the product is created.
parameters.description_zh: 设备所属产品的ProductKey，创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品生成的唯一标识。
parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform when the product is created
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属产品的ProductKey，创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品生成的唯一标识
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the source instance to which the device belongs:

- Public instance ID: iotx-oxssharez200.
    > Currently, only the China (Shanghai) region is supported, and its instance ID is iotx-oxssharez200.

- Enterprise instance ID: Log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Instance Overview** page, click the instance name. On the **Instance Details** page, view the **Instance ID** in the **Instance Basic Information** section.
parameters.description_zh:
设备所属的源实例ID：

- 公共实例ID：iotx-oxssharez200。
    > 目前仅支持华东2（上海）地域，其实例ID为iotx-oxssharez200。

- 企业版实例ID：登录物联网平台控制台，在**实例概览**页面，单击实例名称，在**实例详情**页面的**实例基本信息**中查看**实例ID**。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the target instance to which the device is migrated. Only Enterprise instances are supported as the target instance.

You can log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Instance Overview** page, click the instance name. On the **Instance Details** page, view the **Instance ID** in the **Instance Basic Information** section.
